lectures.title: World Geography: firsts in geography and exploration

items: **Eratosthenes:** first to calculate Earth’s circumference accurately; coined the term “Geography” (Father of Geography).
**Anaximander:** first known Greek to draw a world map (6th century BCE).
**South Pole:** first person to reach it was **Roald Amundsen** (1911).
**North Pole:** first to reach it is disputed: **Robert Peary** / **Frederick Cook**.
